# Vendored parser

`pycparser/` is pycparser **3.00**, copied from the installed Codex Python
runtime distribution. Its BSD license is retained verbatim in
`PYCPARSER-LICENSE`. Source files are unmodified. The compiler uses its syntax
parser/AST only; all TS201 semantic checking and code generation are original.

Upstream project: https://github.com/eliben/pycparser

No ADI proprietary libraries, compiler binaries, runtime or SDK are bundled.
